automation.vaultExplainTitle: What are OpenBao / Vault Compatible Routes (/v1/pki/*)?
automation.vaultExplainDesc: Many existing tools (Kubernetes cert-manager, Terraform, Vault CLI, Consul) already speak HashiCorp Vault / OpenBao PKI API. By exposing /v1/pki/issue/{profile} and /v1/pki/revoke, those tools can request certificates directly from this CA using your API token as X-Vault-Token — zero custom plugin required.
automation.acmeExplainTitle: What is the ACME Directory Endpoint (/acme/directory)?
automation.acmeExplainDesc: ACME (RFC 8555) is the standard protocol used by Let's Encrypt, Caddy, Traefik, and Certbot. The /acme/directory URL tells ACME clients where to fetch nonces, create orders, and download certificates automatically.
